nodes.text:
Absolute URI autolinks are parsed identically to [label](target) links and
routed through the URL policy. Safe schemes pass: https://example.com and
mailto:foo@bar.com become standard links.

Bare email autolinks acquire a mailto: scheme so they are gated by the
same allowlist: foo@bar.com.

Full URLs with path, query, and fragment survive verbatim:
https://example.com/path?q=1#frag.

Disambiguation: <not a url> contains whitespace and stays literal text;
the empty form <> is never an autolink either.

Multiple autolinks on one paragraph parse independently:
https://a.example.com followed by text and mailto:other@example.com.
